reason: ASK-4948: wire tool-output-trim.py once at USER level (~/.claude/settings.json, apply with --root $HOME) so every repo gets trimmed Bash output, including repos with no kipi project settings (chief had none; its builders ran 206k to 242k median context). It runs the copy in the pinned dispatch checkout, which tracks origin/main, never the shared human checkout. Repos that also wire it (kipi project settings, the worker --settings guard set) are trimmed once: the hook claims each tool_use_id with O_EXCL and a second copy prints nothing. Guarded with test -f, fails open, off switch KIPI_OUTPUT_TRIM=0. Applied by kipi-update.sh install_vendored_hooks.
